lede: The gondola's future takes center stage this week, with SMART's board voting Wednesday on two vendor contracts for structural analysis — essentially the engineering step that tells us whether the aging gondola cabins and structure can keep running — and the Gondola Leadership Committee meeting Monday to dig into funding commitments and project direction. Alongside that, Town Planning and Zoning takes up three Town-owned redevelopment projects Thursday, including the Carhenge site on West Pacific, while Town Council sits as a liquor authority Sunday for a KOTO Radio event permit hearing.
